def get_by_plate(self, plate) -> Car | False:
        vehicle = self.repo.get_by_plate(plate)
        
        if vehicle:
            car = Car(
                plate               = vehicle[0],
                model               = vehicle[1],

                mileage             = vehicle[4],
                average_consumption = vehicle[5],
                status              = vehicle[6],
                max_fuel            = vehicle[7],
                fuel                = vehicle[8],
                ports               = vehicle[9],
                license             = VehicleLicense.B
            )

            return car
        
        return False
